countability_resolution_rule: All three canonical countability authorities must agree. A stale or contradictory task-registry activation_status field has zero authority and must not make a countable cohort non-countable or vice versa.
task_registry_mutation_policy: Schedule/task-registry changes are prospective only and require scheduler admission before a countable successor is promoted.
production_activation_rule: CURRENT_EXACT_COHORT_G_PLUS_ROLE_NORMALIZED_FIRST_PRODUCTION_NOT_BEFORE; EARLY DOWNSTREAM HOURLY WAKES ARE HEARTBEAT_ONLY
time_authority: EXACT_TZID_AMERICA_VANCOUVER_HOURLY_BYMINUTE_GRAMMAR; FROZEN POST_2007_CANADA_PACIFIC OFFSET RULE; WORKER OCCURRENCES DERIVED FROM COHORT PRODUCTION_NOT_BEFORE; MM06 FIRST COUNTABLE OCCURRENCE IS STRICTLY AFTER MAXIMUM WORKER DEADLINE; MF06 AND BIL00 FIRST COUNTABLE OCCURRENCES ARE STRICTLY AFTER THEIR PREDECESSOR START PLUS THE EXACT ACCEPTED-MAIN MAX-ATTEMPT-PLUS-JITTER COMPLETION BUDGET; EARLY WAKES ARE HEARTBEAT_ONLY; DST TRANSITION OR AMBIGUITY FAILS CLOSED
preactivation_observation_authority: EXACT_RECEIPT_HEAD TRUSTED STATUS SERVER CREATED_AT MUST FALL IN SIGNED_FROZEN_CHALLENGE THROUGH CHALLENGE_PLUS_MAX_ATTEMPT_PLUS_JITTER AND NOT AFTER ADMISSION_CUTOFF
retry_budget_formula: deadline_minus_first_production >= cadence + max_attempt_duration + jitter AND deadline_minus_second_production >= max_attempt_duration + jitter
fail_closed_rule: If canonical state/control/assignment disagree, task identity or normalized scheduler readback drifts, preactivation admission is absent, or any required evidence is unknown, validation fails and no calibration credit is allowed. A receipt without a trusted at-or-before-deadline witness is late or timing-unknown and cannot reopen a frozen MISSING partition.
